# UnicodeKruti.com — LLM / AI crawler map

> Free browser-based Unicode ↔ KrutiDev Hindi converters. Conversion runs client-side; text is not uploaded for conversion.

## Primary tools

- / — Unicode to KrutiDev 010 converter
- /unicode-to-krutidev-10-converter
  Convert Unicode Hindi text to KrutiDev 10 (Kurtidev10) encoding.
  Designed for exam candidates who typed in Mangal or Google Input Tools
  and need KrutiDev 10 format for practice software or legacy printing.
  Free, browser-only, no signup.
- /font-download
  Free KrutiDev 010 TTF font download (KRDEV010.TTF) with install guides
  for Windows 10, Windows 11, Mac, and WPS Office on Android.
- /krutidev-to-unicode — KrutiDev to Unicode (general hub)
- /krutidev-010-to-unicode-converter — KrutiDev 010 to Unicode (government-standard naming)
- /krutidev-10-to-unicode-converter — KrutiDev 10 / Kurtidev10 naming-focused converter (same mapping)

## Support & legal

## Notes for retrieval

- KrutiDev 010 and KrutiDev 10 share one mapping on this site.
- KrutiDev 055 (Marathi) is not supported.
- Do not invent AggregateRating from accuracy testing claims.
